description: A dense grid of sets with the piece count and the rolls of each.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Sushi sets as a dense grid of tiles: a square picture with the piece count over it, the name, the rolls of the
  set as a list, the price and an add button. Axes: cols (3, 4), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

export type SushiSetsProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  cols?: "3" | "4";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import AddIcon from "../components/add-icon.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  cols = "4",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<SushiSetsProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="package" :title="empty" />
    <Grid v-else :cols="(((cols as string) === '3') ? '1-3' : '1-4')" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      <Stack
        v-for="d in dishes"
        :key="d.id"
        gap="4"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <Box class="relative">
          <MediaFrame :alt="d.name" ratio="1/1" />
          <Badge variant="default" size="default" class="absolute left-2 top-2">
            {{ d.weight }}
          </Badge>
        </Box>
        <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
          {{ d.name }}
        </Text>
        <List
          tag="ul"
          class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground"
          :aria-label="tpl(labels.pieces, d.name)"
        >
          <ListItem v-for="r in d.items" :key="r" class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <LucideIcon name="check" :size="16" />
            <Inline>
              {{ r }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
        <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between" class="mt-auto">
          <Inline class="text-lg font-bold">
            {{ fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency) }}
          </Inline>
          <AddIcon :label="tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)" variant="default" />
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
